results.title: Zanaga undergoes bulk sampling programme
results.description: Aim-listed Zanaga Iron Ore Company (ZIOC) has provided an update on the bulk sampling programme at its Zanaga project in Congo-Brazzaville. As part of the programme, about 30 000 t of ore is being extracted to assemble a 100 t composite sample of the hematite zone targeted for Stage 1’s 12-million-tonne-a-year operations.
